nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How can increased efficiency affect diesel fuel consumption and CO2 emissions?
nodes.answer: Increased efficiency can lead to a reduction in diesel fuel consumption and a subsequent decrease in CO2 emissions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Production carbon footprint reduction|Fuel-efficient driving habits_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the GUTB technique in relation to tractor fuel consumption?
nodes.answer: The GUTB (Gear-up and Throttle-back) technique is a fuel-saving practice that improves engine efficiency by maintaining high engine load and operating engine speed at 60-80% of rated speed when drawbar loads are light, typically at 75% of rated power or less.

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How does adaptive driving rely on operator feedback?
nodes.answer: Adaptive driving depends on the operator receiving accurate feedback on both engine performance and driver performance.
